Question
========
You include a local image in a page using a plain relative path, `images/photo.jpg`. The image displays correctly on
that page, but breaks when the same image is included from a page in a different folder. What is the most reliable fix?

Answerlist
----------
* Rename the image file.
* Move the image next to every page that uses it.
* Use a project-relative path with a leading slash, e.g. `/assets/images/photo.jpg`.
* Convert the image to a different file format.

Solution
========

Answerlist
----------
* Wrong: renaming the file doesn't address how the path is resolved.
* Wrong: duplicating the image across folders works but isn't a reliable or maintainable fix.
* Correct: a leading `/` makes the path resolve from the project root regardless of which page includes it.
* Wrong: the file format has no bearing on how the path is resolved.
